groups.note: E1 の「韓国人には…ということわざがある」は英語の補い
E23（漢字の元の意味は好きだ）は英語だけ。食い違い: 韓国語は「教会という言葉のせいで人と僕が分かれる理由はない」、英語 E28 は「人が分かち合う理由にはならない」と意味が変わっている
diff: The Korean original says the word church gives no reason for others and himself to be divided (English edition: “does not provide any reason for people to share with each other”).

groups.note: 食い違い: 韓国語は「教会を思って行きたいと心で思えば、体がどこにあっても僕のすることが全部見え、聞こえた」、英語 E61 は「来た人はだれでも僕のすることを見聞きできた」とする
diff: The Korean original says that whenever members thought of the church and wished in their hearts to go there, they could see and hear all he was doing, wherever their bodies were (English edition: “Anyone who came there could see what I was doing and hear what I was saying”).

groups.note: E65 の「嫁ぎ先の家族が」髪を剃ったというのは英語だけ
食い違い: 韓国語は「一日に数十人ずつ」寮を出た、英語 E78 は「それが一日で起きた」とする
diff: The Korean original says dozens of Ewha students left the dormitory each day (English edition: “This happened on a single day”).

groups.note: 金活蘭の「총장（総長）」を英語は Dean とする
diff: The Korean original calls Hwal Ran Kim the president of Ewha Womans University (English edition: “Dean”).

groups.note: E95 は「僕の説教だけを聞け、うちの教会だけに通えと強いたことはない」の「だけ」を落とし、意味が強くなっている
diff: The Korean original says he never forced anyone to listen only to his sermons or attend only his church (English edition: “I never told anyone to listen to my sermons or attend our church”).
